newsitem.title: USA: Asset Investors buys mobile home interests.
newsitem.headline: Asset Investors buys mobile home interests.

text.p: Asset Investors Corp said Friday that it has acquired interests in eight manufactured housing communities in the Tampa, Florida area, and a related manufactured housing community management business from Brandywine Communities for $29.4 million.
The consideration was $2.9 million of cash, the assumption of $5.0 million of existing debt, 363,372 shares of Asset Investors stock and 91,760 operating partnership units of the company.
The company said that it has also formed an alliance with Brandywine Communities to acquire and manage additional manufactured housing communities.
The company said that building a portfolio of manufactured housing communities is part of its multi-step plan to reduce portfolio risks.
The transaction is Asset Investors' first acquisition of equity real estate interests, and the company said it expects to acquire more manufactured housing communities.
